name: SEELE
subtitle: Panacea Medical Biosphere & Rapid Relief Specialist

versions.quote: Don't be afraid. Whether life or light, I will safeguard you to the gentle shore.
versions.description: Synthesized with cellular rejuvenation catalysts and quantum biospheric restoration protocols. Seele serves as the primary medical and psychological stabilizer under the Humanitarian Charter, reversing catastrophic physical wounds and restoring ecological quarantine biomes.

workExperience.desc: Coordinates zero-credit disaster medical drops and rapid bio-restoration triage stations.
Administered nanotech surgical repair units in contaminated and hazardous radiation zones.

abilities.name: Panacea Bloom Sanctuary
abilities.desc: Emits radiant sub-space medical field accelerating patient wound closure by 980%.

abilities.name: Quantum Rejuvenation Veil
abilities.desc: Purges toxicity, radiation, and biochemical pathogens in a 50-meter diameter sphere.

abilities.name: Mirror Butterfly Resurgence
abilities.desc: Creates empathic life-force partitions shielding critical patients from lethal shock.
